{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Go
on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "privatedial" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main", "privatedial" ]
jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      NGROK_TEST_FLAKEY: 1
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
    - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@ba0dd844c9180cbf77aa72a116d6fbc515d0e87b # v27
    - uses: HatsuneMiku3939/direnv-action@fe6ca688de409566c44001c1e65ad6925f0e9cbb # v1
    - name: direnv allow
      run: direnv allow .
    - name: go mod tidy
      run: direnv exec . go mod tidy
    - name: exit if not tidy
      run: |
        git diff --exit-code go.mod
        git diff --exit-code go.sum
    - name: Build
      run: direnv exec . go build -v ./...
    - name: Build Examples
      run: direnv exec . go build -C ./examples -v ./...
    - name: Test
      run: direnv exec . go test -v ./...
  patched-go:
    name: Go ${{ matrix.go }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go: ['1.26.10', '1.27.3']
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
      NGROK_TEST_FLAKEY: 1
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
    - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go }}
        cache: true
    - name: Build
      run: go build -v ./...
    - name: Build Examples
      run: go build -C ./examples -v ./...
    - name: Test
      run: go test -v ./...
  online-tests:
    name: Online tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork
    env:
      NGROK_TEST_ONLINE: 1
      NGROK_TEST_FLAKEY: 1
      NGROK_AUTHTOKEN: ${{ secrets.NGROK_AUTHTOKEN }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
    - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@ba0dd844c9180cbf77aa72a116d6fbc515d0e87b # v27
    - uses: HatsuneMiku3939/direnv-action@fe6ca688de409566c44001c1e65ad6925f0e9cbb # v1
    - name: direnv allow
      run: direnv allow .
    - name: Test
      run: direnv exec . go test -mod=readonly -v ./...",
  "rationale": "Add Go dependency/module caching to the patched-go job, which already uses actions/setup-go, by enabling its cache: true option. This caches the Go module and build caches across runs, keyed by dependency files (go.sum exists in the repository), matching the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency-cache pattern measured on Go workflows. All existing build and test steps are preserved unchanged, so coverage is intact, and no new permissions, secrets, network access, or deployment operations are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
